scope: Single-user emotional check-in island with deterministic fallback, crisis interception, graph-backed entities, interactions, intentions and reset. Excludes optional live LLM classification and guidance.
assumption: The first build uses an empty Jac 0.34.27 workspace and does not require a model API key.
constraints: The core check-in flow must work without an API key.

tasks.request: Build a small reflective check-in app. A person can describe how they feel and see that feeling appear as an object on an island. They can place it, try a gentle interaction, choose one concrete next action, and reset the island. Keep the check-in history in a graph so the stages are connected. Show a direct crisis-support message for urgent language, and make the main flow work without an AI key.
acceptance: A fresh visit shows an empty island and available interactions.
A check-in creates pending feelings that can be placed and interacted with.
An intention can be attached to a placed feeling and viewed as part of its path.
Crisis language does not create a feeling and shows support guidance.

files.purpose: Declare the Jac web app entry, runtime dependencies and local serve route.
Define the island graph, deterministic check-in and crisis guard, plus public walkers for placing, interacting, committing an intention, viewing the path and resetting.
Style the island, feeling objects, interaction controls, intention area and crisis message.
Render the island and forms, call the public walkers and display their actual responses.
Expose the single-page Jac client entry and register the app's server endpoints.

ui.design_rationale: The island metaphor and clear stage controls make the check-in flow visible.

verify.steps: Open an empty island, enter a feeling, place a resulting entity, apply an interaction, commit an intention, verify the path, then reset. Also submit urgent language and confirm no entity is created.
